name: Always Dental Care
hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 9 am to 6 pm. Wed 9 am to 5 pm. Fri 9 am to 1 pm. Closed Sat and Sun.
description: Always Dental Care is Dr. Truong Nguyen's general and cosmetic dental practice in Phoenixville, PA, offering cleanings, Invisalign, whitening, veneers, root canals, extractions, and wisdom teeth removal.

hero.eyebrow: Phoenixville, PA | Family and cosmetic dentistry
hero.headline: Dentist in Phoenixville, PA
hero.sub: Dr. Truong Nguyen, DDS, has cared for Phoenixville for 11 years, from routine cleanings to Invisalign and veneers, on Egypt Road.

offerings.heading: General care and <mark>cosmetic work.</mark>
items: General dentistry: exams, cleanings, fillings, and preventive care
Root canals, extractions, and wisdom teeth removal
Evening hours until 6 pm three days a week

story.heading: One dentist, eleven years
paragraphs: Always Dental Care is a single-dentist practice led by Dr. Truong Nguyen, DDS, treating Phoenixville families for 11 years from 1570 Egypt Road.
The visits people put off and the ones they look forward to happen in the same chair.

experience.heading: What a visit is like
items: Call to book; evening slots Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.
Suite 210 on Egypt Road, parking outside the building.
Treatment plans explained before anything starts.

feature.heading: Invisalign and whitening, in the same chair
feature.text: Straightening and brightening are both done here, so a better smile does not require a second office.

closing.heading: Family and cosmetic dentistry in Phoenixville
